subject: ADR-181: the charts, read (2) -- the compost log, the splay chart, the 2-3-4 view and the trap count held to their own scales; charts held 4 -> 8; two suite pages republished
body: ADR-140'S LEFTOVERS, FOUR OF THEM. ADR-140 gave read-report a charts channel and held four drawings, naming the tree proofs, cp-bench and soil-bench as drawing unasserted; their tasks ran every slice since with charts in every read-report and nothing holding it. Now: the soil bench's compost chart is held to a Python port of its scale (verify_soil states the example's eighteen readings and five turnings; the page's circles, threshold lines, turning ticks and peak are held to cx/cy; the task's marks, labels, first/peak/last centres and empty points are held to the port -- a tenth off fails); the tree proofs' splay chart's last-bar centre is recomputed from the held ticks (quarters of one ceiling) and the held last actual cost, so a transcribed literal cannot pass a scale it does not fit (a hundredth off fails), and its 2-3-4 view is held to what a 2-3-4 tree is (groups sorted, root separating leaves, 13-15 keys); the cp-bench's trap-count chart, hidden at the task's end, is read on the plants pane and held to the task's own name and count entries. page-soil-bench 78 -> 86, page-tree-proofs 186 -> 195, page-cp-bench 104 -> 109; verify_soil 80, verify_proofs 143, verify_cp 88. soil-suite.html 80/80 and cp-suite.html 88/88 verified, republished and measured. Charts held 4 -> 8. No instrument page was edited.
